subject: AWS Marketplace: product page eligibility checks, hero visuals, and co-sell playbook
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace: product page eligibility checks, hero visuals, and co-sell playbook

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. I promised to send a concise checklist for the marketplace product page items we need to verify before we can submit and request co-sell approval. Attached is a draft product page PDF and a zip with a few hero image options.

Quick asks from our side so we can target the AWS review window next week:
- Can you confirm whether CloudBridge will provide a SOC 2 attestation or will we link to your hosted security page?
- Confirm the supported regions for the initial offering (US East, US West) and whether APAC is planned for Q4.
- Help us pick one hero image (A/B shown in the zip) and approve the short tagline (two-line max) — see page 1 of the draft.

I've looped in Marissa and Ben for co-sell collateral and SKU mapping. If we can lock these by EOD Friday (10/9) we can submit the AWS listing and request co-sell enablement the following Monday.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace GTM | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0118

Attachments: product_page_draft_v3.pdf, hero_images.zip

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: product page eligibility checks, hero visuals, and co-sell playbook

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers inline: 
- SOC 2: we have a Type II in process; for now we can link to our security page (https://cloudbridge.com/security) and provide the auditor contact. Final attestation will be available late Nov.
- Regions: initial launch is US East and US West; APAC planned for Dec.
- Hero: we prefer image_B_highres.jpg (in the zip). Tagline suggestion: “Low-latency LLM inference for regulated apps.” Short and accurate for the product page.

We reviewed the draft and left a few minor copy edits (separate doc). Marcus will coordinate legal for marketplace eligibility items that may need contract language.

—Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
lena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com

> (see above)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: product page eligibility checks, hero visuals, and co-sell playbook

Adding SKU/visibility notes — team,

I did a quick pass on the draft (product_page_draft_v3.pdf) and flagged the following that will block visibility in the AWS catalog if not corrected: 
1) Make the 'Supported CPUs/GPUs' field explicit — list the instance families we recommend (g4, g5, p4) and include guidance on recommended batch sizes.
2) Pricing tier labels should match our billing schema: "Standard", "Dedicated-1", "Dedicated-2" — avoid custom wording on the public page.
3) PrivateOffer/Trial: confirm the trial length we can offer via PrivateOffer (14 days vs 30 days). AWS has a PrivateOffer lifecycle that will surface differently in the console.

Action items for CloudBridge: confirm trial length and any usage caps during trial. Marissa — can you draft the SKU map CSV? Karthik — can you confirm the tech claims wording (latency numbers) with the infra team?

—Ben
Ben Carter
GTM Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@novushealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 13:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: product page eligibility checks, hero visuals, and co-sell playbook

Kimberly / Lena —

Novus Health is happy to serve as an early reference and we can provide a short customer quote for the listing (one sentence about latency and reliability). We also need to confirm whether we should appear in the 'Customers' section of the product page or link to a case study page.

Two small asks from our side: 
- Can you confirm the data residency statement that will be shown to customers? We operate in regulated healthcare and need the language to be explicit.
- Will PrivateOffer pricing be visible to our account teams? If not, we'll need the deal-specific DocuSign route.

Happy to hop on a 20 min call if useful.

—Marcus
Marcus Hale
Head of Platform Engineering | Novus Health
marcus.hale@novushealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>, Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@novushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: product page eligibility checks, hero visuals, and co-sell playbook

Team —

Attached: co-sell-playbook-draft.docx and a provisional SKU map CSV. Highlights/follow-ups:
- SKU map: three tiers (Standard, Dedicated-1, Dedicated-2) with clear seat/throughput assumptions. Please review and flag any mismatch to your pricing model.
- Co-sell playbook: includes sample email templates for account teams, a 1-pager to include in the AWS listing collateral, and a short checklist for marketplace managers.
- I suggested language for data residency ("Customer data is stored in regionally isolated environments and processed per customer-controlled configs"). Marcus — can you confirm if that wording is acceptable for healthcare compliance?

Next milestones:
- EOD Monday (10/12): finalize hero image, tagline, SKU map and trial length.
- Tue (10/13): submit to AWS marketplace review and request co-sell enablement.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Partnerships & Marketplace | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: co-sell-playbook-draft.docx, sku_map_provisional.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>, Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@novushealth.com>, aws-marketplace-review@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: product page eligibility checks, hero visuals, and co-sell playbook

Quick status update — final items below. Thanks everyone for the fast turn-around on Monday morning.

Resolved/Confirmed:
- Hero image: CloudBridge confirmed image_B_highres.jpg.
- Tagline: approved as "Low-latency LLM inference for regulated apps."
- Regions: US East/West initial. APAC in December.
- Data residency language: Marcus approved as-is for the marketplace blurb.
- SKU map: Marissa uploaded the provisional CSV to the Drive link; Ben and Karthik to sync on instance family details before submission.
- Trial length: CloudBridge confirmed 14-day PrivateOffer trial.

Open items (blocking submission if unresolved):
- AWS action: aws-marketplace-review@amazon.com — can you confirm the expected review timeline once we submit (standard vs expedited)?
- Legal: final PrivateOffer terms and whether we should route DocuSign for Novus Health.

Next steps (short):
1) Karthik/Bob from infra to add the recommended instance families in the technical claims copy (by EOD 10/12).
2) Marissa to finalize SKU CSV and mark the public pricing tiers.
3) I will package the final product_page.zip (PDF + hero + SKU map + co-sell playbook) and submit to AWS for listing review on Tue 10/13 morning.

If there are no objections, I will proceed with the submission and request co-sell enablement concurrently.

Best —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace GTM | Redwood Inference

Standard review timeline is 5-7 business days; expedited reviews are possible with a fee and proof of sales readiness. Please include clear SKU mapping and compliance links to reduce back-and-forth.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Intake Team
